title: Optical Fibre Engineer Roadmap
summary: Build from telecom fundamentals into optical communication, fibre installation/testing, network design, and eventually optical transport and telecom infrastructure leadership.

facts.Timeline assumption: 4-year B.Tech/B.E. from 2026–2030. If your university offers a 4-year honours/research pathway, use the additional year/credits for deeper optical communications, networking, research, or an industry project.

horizons.question: What can I enter now?
horizons.output: Build electronics, communication, networking and fibre-optics fundamentals; complete practical fibre/network projects and internships.

horizons.question: How should I specialise?
horizons.output: Move into fibre deployment, optical transmission, FTTH, network operations, testing, commissioning or optical network design.

horizons.question: How should I evolve?
horizons.output: Progress toward senior optical/network engineering, transmission planning, project engineering, network optimisation or specialist roles.

horizons.question: How can I remain relevant?
horizons.output: Combine optical infrastructure with 5G/6G transport, automation, cloud networking, network management and next-generation optical systems.

rows.text: Engineering mathematics, basic electronics, electrical circuits, C/Python basics
Digital electronics, signals and systems, communication fundamentals
Optical communication, fibre structure, attenuation, dispersion, light sources and detectors
Fibre installation, splicing, connectors, OTDR and optical power measurement
Telecom networks, Ethernet, IP networking, FTTH/PON and transmission systems
DWDM, optical transport, network monitoring and troubleshooting

blocks.text: 4-year honours variant
Use the additional academic depth for optical network design, photonics, fibre sensing, DWDM, 5G/6G transport, network automation, research or an industry-sponsored project.
